description: The DUPREC half of the same arm, and this one is reached by data rather than by forcing. USERIDI is ADMIN001, which app/jcl/DUSRSECJ.jcl:L35 already seeds, so the WRITE at app/cbl/COUSR01C.cbl:240-248 collides on the primary key and a KSDS answers DUPREC - RESP 14 where case08 forced RESP 15. Read the two cases together: the message, the cursor and the eighty-byte final state are byte-identical across them, which is what 'the two WHEN clauses share one action' asserts. Splitting them into separate arms with separate texts would pass case08 and fail this one, or the reverse, and never both. HOW THE WRITE IS REACHED AT ALL: all five received fields arrive non-blank, so every arm of the ordered EVALUATE TRUE at :117-151 is refused and control falls to WHEN OTHER at :148-150, which moves -1 into FNAMEL and does nothing else. WS-ERR-FLG therefore stays 'N', the guard IF NOT ERR-FLG-ON at :153 is true, :154-158 load the five spans of SEC-USER-DATA and :159 performs WRITE-USER-SEC-FILE. THE ARM: :260 WHEN DFHRESP(DUPKEY) and :261 WHEN DFHRESP(DUPREC) are consecutive WHEN clauses with no statements between them - COBOL's way of writing 'either of these' - so both fall into :262-266, which raises WS-ERR-FLG, moves 'User ID already exist...' to WS-MESSAGE, moves -1 into USERIDL at :265 and sends. USERIDL is a length item and therefore cursor metadata, never a payload member; the WHEN OTHER arm two lines further on at :272 uses FNAMEL instead, which is exactly the difference case10 pins. THE MESSAGE, DERIVED MECHANICALLY: the literal at :263 is 24 characters; it lands in WS-MESSAGE PIC X(80) as 24 + 56 spaces, and :188 moves that into ERRMSGO OF COUSR1AO, declared PIC X(78) in app/cpy-bms/COUSR01.CPY:164, which truncates an alphanumeric receiver on the RIGHT to give 24 + 54 spaces. Both widths are stated as separate channels because an 80-byte working-storage field and a 78-byte screen field are different things. THE SEND: :266 performs SEND-USRADD-SCREEN at :184-196, which first performs POPULATE-HEADER-INFO at :214-233 - TITLE01O and TITLE02O from app/cpy/COTTL01Y.cpy, where the ' Credit Card Demo Application (CCDA) ' literal is commented out so TITLE02O is the CardDemo line, TRNNAMEO 'CU01', PGMNAMEO 'COUSR01C', and CURDATEO mm/dd/yy with CURTIMEO hh:mm:ss from FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE - and then sends MAP('COUSR1A') MAPSET('COUSR01'). Exactly one SEND occurs on this path, so exactly one send and one message pair. The five typed values are echoed unchanged because INITIALIZE-ALL-FIELDS at :287-295 is performed only from the NORMAL arm at :252 and from the PF4 path at :281, neither of which is taken here. ERRMSGC keeps the map's default colour: MOVE DFHGREEN TO ERRMSGC at :254 is the only attribute assignment anywhere in the program and it sits in the NORMAL arm, so no error arm sets a colour. This program copies neither CSSETATY nor CSSTRPFY, so there is no '*' marker and no per-field DFHRED to expect, and COPY DFHATTR at :57 is commented out, so no DFHATTR constant is compiled in. NOTHING IS WRITTEN: the arm raised WS-ERR-FLG and the WRITE was refused by the file, so expectedWrites is empty - a positive assertion that no record reached the dataset, not an absence of interest. expectedFinalState pins all ten rows at their full eighty bytes, each the 57 seeded characters plus the 23 spaces of SEC-USR-FILLER, and expectedDatasets pins USRSEC at exactly 10 rows of 80 bytes on the final-state channel, so an eleventh row cannot appear unnoticed and no id absent from the seed - the ADMIN001 collision is with row 0, and nothing new is created - may turn up in the dataset. THE SCOPE OF PASSWORD VALIDATION, STATED DELIBERATELY: blankness is the ONLY password check COUSR01C performs, at :136-141, the arm case05 pins. There is no minimum length, no maximum beyond the truncation PASSWDI PIC X(8) at app/cpy-bms/COUSR01.CPY:78 already imposes, no character-class requirement, no confirmation field, no history check, no expiry and no comparison against the user id. This rejection is therefore decided solely by the KSDS primary-key collision and never by a credential rule. PASSWDI arrives as the literal PASSWORD - eight characters, an exact fit for SEC-USR-PWD PIC X(08) in app/cpy/CSUSR01Y.cpy - and is carried in plaintext, exactly as all ten app/jcl/DUSRSECJ.jcl rows hold it on disk. No hashing, no encoding and no strength rule is applied or expected: the security posture is neither weakened nor unrequestedly strengthened, and adding any such rule would be a new feature and a parity violation. DETERMINISM AND ENCODING: the pinned instant 2022-07-19T23:12:34 is the source's own version footer at :298, shared by all twenty cases of this folder, so CURDATEO and CURTIMEO depend on no wall clock; the charset is named explicitly as US-ASCII rather than left to a platform default. STATELESSNESS: eibcalen 160 is the exact byte total of CARDDEMO-COMMAREA in app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy (4+8+4+8+8+1+1+9+25+25+25+11+1+16+7+7), the commarea and the AID travel in the payload, and the response echoes all sixteen fields unchanged because this path neither transfers control nor flips CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT, which already arrives as 1. PROVENANCE: every expected value here is statically derived by structured reading of app/cbl/COUSR01C.cbl:117-160, :184-196, :214-233 and :240-274, cross-checked against the field widths in app/cpy-bms/COUSR01.CPY, the byte layout of app/cpy/CSUSR01Y.cpy, the title literals in app/cpy/COTTL01Y.cpy, the commarea layout in app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy and the seed rows in app/jcl/DUSRSECJ.jcl:L35-44. It was NOT captured from, recorded against or replayed from any execution of the legacy COBOL: executing these programs is empirically impossible in this environment, with eight independently verified blockers - no z/OS or CICS runtime, the available compiler's indexed file handler disabled, no Language Environment CEE* services, and DFHAID, DFHBMSCA and DFHATTR absent from the repository among them. No user rules were provided for this project, so this fixture is held to enterprise-standard practice instead: exact verified values with no placeholders, widths summed mechanically from PICTURE clauses, the legacy wording preserved rather than tidied, and the reference sources under app/cbl, app/cpy, app/cpy-bms and app/jcl read and never modified.
